headline.purpose: Section headings; same local code family

layout.aboutMinHeight: calc(100svh - 96px); calc(100svh - 123px) at <=600px; content may expand
layout.aboutComposition: heading/background left, portrait/biography right, toolkit and project link below; mobile portrait/biography before background
layout.projectsLink: direct link on every viewport; compact header link at <=900px
layout.experience: two compact horizontal cards; one column below 900px
layout.motionControls: fixed bottom-right; hidden under work overlay

focus.anchorNavigation: destination heading focus; prevent secondary scroll

particles.selection: two nearest candidates per point, deduplicated edges
particles.drift: alternating left/right; cycle speed 0.012 + random(i + 2100) * 0.004 per second

nameScan.reveal: finite left-to-right clip reveal and beam; solid letters, no blinking
nameScan.fallback: disabled by pause and reduced motion

entrances.fill: both during playback; cancel after committing visible state
entrances.rearm: fully offscreen, never during playback; recheck after completion

boundary.touch: completed vertical swipe greater than 45px, using start scroll position
boundary.withinAbout: native scrolling when taller than the viewport; guided onward transition at its end
boundary.exclusions: pause/reduced motion; open work overlay/native dialog; input controls and modified keyboard/wheel gestures
boundary.anchor: ordinary href remains usable without JavaScript

fallbacks.pause: cancel entrance motion, reveal targets, clear transforms and chromatic shadows, draw static canvas
fallbacks.reducedMotion: static content and native scrolling; motion controls disabled
fallbacks.offscreen: hero canvas stops; reactive state settles; portrait loop cancels

motion.progress: actual document scroll ratio; empty at top, full at bottom

content.legacyDestinations: article URLs, project sheets and media interactions retained

provenance.portrait: provisional stock demo, not Quentin; source in data-source; real profile photo reserved for Person metadata
provenance.cv: existing published Software Engineer CV, not newly updated

evidence.providedBy: parent implementation and finish review; documentation author ran no tests
automated: test:dev: Markdown rebuild, live reload and source isolation passed
evidence.visual: fresh desktop/mobile finish review: SHIP for local review; no material UI findings; design-record alignment requested

components.name: Motion control
components.description: Pause button appearance; page script owns its pressed state and shared motion event.
components.html: <button class="ds-motion" type="button" aria-label="Pause animations" aria-pressed="false"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 5v14M16 5v14"/></svg></button>

components.name: Section link
components.description: Stable navigation with a centered underline and current-location state; a separate compact Projects link remains available at <=900px.
components.css: .ds-sections{display:flex;gap:24px;font-family:Manrope,sans-serif}.ds-sections a{position:relative;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted,#b9becd);padding:12px 0;text-decoration:none}.ds-sections a:after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:4px;height:1px;left:0;right:0;background:var(--accent,#eeb9a2);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:center;transition:transform .3s}.ds-sections a:hover,.ds-sections a[aria-current]{color:var(--fg,#ececf2)}.ds-sections a:hover:after,.ds-sections a:focus-visible:after,.ds-sections a[aria-current]:after{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-sections a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#eeb9a2);outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-sections a:after{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: Gateway is the selected identity: centered, software engineering as the first work category, restrained interaction and readable static content. This record describes the repository implementation.
dos: Keep content independent from animation code
Keep title ↔ About ↔ projects transitions repeatable, native scrolling inside a tall About and throughout the work, and a direct Projects link on every viewport
Replace the provisional stock portrait before production
donts: Do not restore tunnels or thumbnail selectors; limit the user-approved finite scan to the name, never project cards
Do not describe the stock portrait as Quentin
Do not treat local screenshots as physical-phone or performance verification
